time_format.meaning: Recognized Waybar clock format, or null when unknown or not included.

time_server.meaning: Time server name if observed with NTP enabled.

last_sync.meaning: UTC ISO timestamp of timesync marker mtime, or null when unreadable.

options.meaning: Available timezone and time_format lists of value/label choices. Empty or failed enumerations omit the field.

readonly.meaning: Setting names mapped to reasons they cannot be changed; absent when none applies.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Literal outcomes emitted by the stop and its envelope reader. The envelope reader can also emit missing envelope kernel keys: followed by the comma-joined missing keys. Other ValueError text (including decoding diagnostics) is passed through.
